title: River view midweek, cheapest rate, will not cancel
why: On Monday and Tuesday nights the river-view room is available, so the traveller should get exactly what they asked for. The Saver rate is cheapest and they said they will not cancel; that it is non-refundable still has to be said. Everything needed was in the message, so a follow-up question is friction.
message: Two of us at Casa Halcy, Monday to Wednesday next week. It has to be the river view room. Cheapest rate, we won't cancel. No breakfast.
